messages:
Maya (Marketing): Draft ready for the product launch blog — link in doc. Need approvals on hero lines, benchmark framing (embeddings vs API baselines), webinar panelists, CTAs, and exact HubSpot field mapping. Can we close today?

Jorge (Product): Read through. Strong work. For benchmarks let's avoid extrapolated percentages; suggest 'up to' language and add test-workload notes. Also propose a short tech blurb about quantization benefits.

Leah (Design): I have three hero direction options: 'Speed-first', 'Cost-smart', and 'Ship faster'. Will export hero variants and suggest mobile crops once copy locks. Need final hero copy to create accessible alt text.

Ivy (Growth): SEO + UTMs: target keyword set in doc. Header CTA should go to webinar RSVP first; secondary CTA -> request demo. Proposed UTM: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=april2026_launch. Also propose analytics event: blog_launch_click with property cta_type.

Alex (Sales Ops): Inbound routing: what required form fields for lead scoring? Recommend fields: company_size, role, intent_choice (demo|webinar|info). Map Enterprise -> AE queue, SMB -> SDR. Provide exact tag values and I'll update routing rules.

Ravi (Engineering): Quick tech quote: "We focused on predictable K/V cache behavior and batching to reduce tail latency in long-context workloads." Fine to shorten for hero. Also can provide a 1-paragraph deep-dive for appendix.

LegalBot: Scan result: phrase 'unlimited throughput' flagged. Please remove or justify. Also need permission for customer name used as a quote placeholder.

Maya (Marketing): Swapped 'unlimited throughput' for 'high-throughput modes' and replaced placeholder customer with 'Customer A (an early access partner)'. Added note to secure approval before publish.

Ivy (Growth): I've added RSVP button wording options: 'Save my seat' and 'Join the webinar'. Leaning towards 'Save my seat' for higher conversion. Also drafting an email reminder flow for registrants (1-day, 1-hour).

Alex (Sales Ops): For tags use `lead_tier=enterprise|smb|demo`, `source=blog`, `intent=webinar|demo`. Will wire these into HubSpot once you confirm exact string values.

Leah (Design): Uploaded hero_speed.jpg, hero_cost.jpg, hero_ship.jpg to assets. Left image captions and alt text suggestions in the doc.

Jorge (Product): For benchmark table: annotated test config (model, seq len, batch size) is added to the doc. That should satisfy reviewers.

LegalBot: Customer placeholder approved pending final consent. Flag cleared for 'high-throughput modes' language.

Maya (Marketing): Locking copy at 16:00 PT. Final checklist: hero variant chosen (Speed), CTO quote shortened (ready), assets uploaded, UTMs and analytics events documented, HubSpot tag strings confirmed. Will schedule to staging.

LaunchBot: Publish window reserved: 2026-04-07 15:00 UTC.

Ivy (Growth): I'll A/B the hero lines: Speed vs Cost for first 24h. Report back on CTR and signups.

Alex (Sales Ops): Routing pushed to staging. I'll monitor first-100 leads and escalate mismatches.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks all — pushing to staging now and will post a quick readout after 24h on conversion and lead quality.
